newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse approves Mezogep listing.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse approves Mezogep listing.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange said on Wednesday that its council conditionally approved the listing of the shares of agricultural machinery company Mezogep Rt.
The 7,926,000 shares, which represent Mezogep's total share capital, will be introduced to the listed "B" category of the bourse, the bourse said in a statement.
Trading in the shares will start once the company meets certain conditions, it said, without specifying the conditions.
Mezogep prepares to offer 64,400 shares of the total to institutional investors at 1,880 forints/share price.
Mezogep shares have a face value of 100 forints.
The subscription period will run from March 12 to 14.
Mezogep is majority owned by Canada's Linamar Corp, whereas CS First Boston will act as lead manager.
